svg.title: cpp-linter: C/C++ pull requests that arrive already checked.
svg.desc: A loop of the ways cpp-linter-action reports on a pull request: file annotations, a thread comment, the step summary, pull request reviews from clang-tidy and clang-format, and auto-fix.
svg.text: clang-format and clang-tidy, reported on the pull request.
